Announces Second Quarter 2023 Financial Results</b></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:12pt;text-align:center;margin:0pt 26.3pt 0pt 0pt;"><font style="font-family:'Arial','Helvetica','sans-serif';font-size:15pt;font-weight:bold;margin-bottom:5pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:5pt;visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:12pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">FREMONT, Calif., August 3, 2023 &#8211; AXT, Inc. (NasdaqGS: AXTI), a leading manufacturer of compound semiconductor wafer substrates, today reported financial results for the second quarter, ended June 30, 2023.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:12pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><font style="visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:12pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><b style="font-weight:bold;">Management Qualitative Comments</b></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:12pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><font style="display:inline-block;visibility:hidden;width:0pt;">&#8203;</font><br><font style="font-family:'\005b8b\004f53';">&#8220;</font>Though the macro environment continues to impact our growth near-term, the trends that have driven our revenue and customer expansion remain very much intact,&#8221; said Morris Young, chief executive officer. &#8220;We continue to excel in our technical capabilities and are readying our business to support new applications in data center, consumer, and other high growth areas. Further, we continue to expand our recycling program and are focused on improving our efficiency and accelerating our return to profitability.&#8221; </p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:12pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><font style="font-weight:bold;visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:12pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><b style="font-weight:bold;">Second Quarter 2023 Results</b></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:12pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><font style="font-weight:bold;visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:12pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">In order to provide better clarity on its operational and financial results, AXT began reporting its financial results on both a GAAP and non-GAAP basis in the third quarter of 2021. Non-GAAP results exclude stock-based compensation expense. Investors can find GAAP to non-GAAP reconciliation tables in the financial statements in this earnings release. &#160;</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:12pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><font style="font-weight:bold;visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p><table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" Market Listing Update</b></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:12pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><font style="font-weight:bold;visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:12pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">On January 10, 2022, AXT announced that Beijing Tongmei Xtal Technology Co., Ltd. (&#8220;Tongmei&#8221;), its subsidiary in Beijing, China, submitted to the Shanghai Stock Exchange (the &#8220;SSE&#8221;) its application to list its shares in an initial public offering (the &#8220;IPO&#8221;) on the SSE&#8217;s Sci-Tech innovAtion boaRd (the &#8220;STAR Market&#8221;) and the application was accepted for review. Subsequently, Tongmei responded to several rounds of questions received from the SSE. On July 12, 2022, the SSE approved the listing of Tongmei&#8217;s shares in an IPO on the STAR Market. <font style="background:#ffffff;">On August 1, 2022, the </font>China Securities Regulatory Commission (the &#8220;CSRC&#8221;) accepted for review <font style="background:#ffffff;">Tongmei&#8217;s IPO application</font>. The STAR Market IPO remains subject to review and approval by the CSRC and other authorities. The process of going public on the STAR Market includes several periods of review and, therefore, is a lengthy process. Subject to review and approval by the CSRC and other authorities, Tongmei hopes to accomplish this goal in the coming months. AXT has posted a brief summary of the plan and the process on its website at http://www.axt.com<u style="color:#0000ff;text-decoration-color:#0000ff;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">.</u></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:12pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><font style="font-weight:bold;visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:12pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><b style="font-weight:bold;">Conference Call</b></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:12pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><font style="font-weight:bold;visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:12pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">The company will host a conference call to discuss these results today at 1:30 p.m. PT. The conference call can be accessed at (888) 300-4150 (passcode 7175811). The call will also be simulcast at www.axt.com. Replays will be available at (800) 770-2030 (passcode 7175811) until August 17, 2023. Financial and statistical information to be discussed in the call will be available on the company&#8217;s website immediately prior to commencement of the call. </i><font style="font-style:italic;">3</font><i style="font-style:italic;"> of 7</i></p></td></tr></table></div><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:12pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">information can be accessed at http://www.axt.com or by calling the company&#8217;s Investor Relations Department at (510) 438-4700.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:12pt;margin:14pt 0pt 0pt 0pt;"><b style="font-weight:bold;">About AXT, Inc. </b></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:12pt;text-align:justify;margin:14pt 0pt 0pt 0pt;">AXT is a material science company that develops and manufactures high-performance compound and single element semiconductor substrate wafers comprising indium phosphide (InP), gallium arsenide (GaAs) and germanium (Ge). The company&#8217;s substrate wafers are used when a typical silicon substrate wafer cannot meet the performance requirements of a semiconductor or optoelectronic device. End markets include 5G infrastructure, data center connectivity (silicon photonics), passive optical networks, LED lighting, lasers, sensors, power amplifiers for wireless devices and satellite solar cells. AXT&#8217;s worldwide headquarters are in Fremont, California where the company maintains sales, administration and customer service functions. AXT has its Asia headquarters in Beijing, China and manufacturing facilities in three separate locations in China. In addition, as part of its supply chain strategy, the company has partial ownership in ten companies in China producing raw materials for its manufacturing process. For more information, see AXT&#8217;s website at http://www.axt.com.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:12pt;text-align:justify;margin:14pt 26.3pt 0pt 0pt;"><b style="font-weight:bold;">Note Regarding Use of Non-GAAP Financial Measures</b></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:12pt;text-align:justify;margin:14pt 0pt 0pt 0pt;">As discussed above, the company provides certain non-GAAP financial measures that exclude stock-based compensation in addition to, and not as a substitute for, or because it believes that such information is superior to, financial measures calculated in accordance with GAAP. The company believes that non-GAAP financial measures, when taken collectively, may be helpful to investors because they provide consistency and comparability with past financial performance and provide better comparability with our peer companies, many of which also use similar non-GAAP financial measures. Further, the company believes that these non-GAAP financial measures offer an important analytical tool to help investors understand the company&#8217;s core operating results and trends. In addition, management uses non-GAAP financial measures to compare the company&#8217;s performance relative to forecasts and strategic plans and to benchmark its performance externally against peer companies. However, non-GAAP financial information is presented for supplemental informational purposes only, has limitations as an analytical tool and should not be considered in isolation or as a substitute for financial information presented in accordance with GAAP. In addition, other companies may calculate similarly-titled non-GAAP financial measures differently or may use other measures to evaluate their performance, all of which could reduce the usefulness of the company&#8217;s non-GAAP financial measures as tools for comparison. The company encourages investors to carefully consider its results under GAAP, as well as its supplemental non&#8208;GAAP information and the reconciliation between these presentations, to more fully understand its business. A reconciliation of our GAAP consolidated financial statements to our non-GAAP consolidated financial statements is provided below.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:12pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt 26.3pt 0pt 0pt;"><font e.removeAttribute('id');a.parentNode.appendChild(e)}}
if(e)e.style.display='block';Show.LastAR=e};Show.hideAR=function(){Show.LastAR.style.display='none'};Show.toggleNext=function(a){var e=a;while(e.nodeName!='DIV')e=e.nextSibling;if(!e.style){}else if(!e.style.display){}else{var d,p_;if(e.style.display=='none'){d='block';p='-'}else{d='none';p='+'}
e.style.display=d;if(a.textContent){a.textContent=p+a.textContent.substring(1)}else{a.innerText=p+a.innerText.substring(1)}}}
